content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Update DocumentLink Fields ## slug: update-documentlink-fields ## seoTitle: Update DocumentLink Fields ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Complete the following steps to change the values in the {{variable.Field_Invoice_AcctNameBillTo}}, {{variable.Field_Invoice_FirstNameBillTo}}, and {{variable.Field_Invoice_LastNameBillTo}} fields, but keep the existing {{variable.Field_Invoice_AccountBillTo}} and {{variable.Field_Invoice_ContactBillTo}} field values. 1. Open an Invoice record. 2. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_Invoice_AcctNameBillTo}} field. 3. Enter a new name. 4. In the {{variable.Field_Invoice_FirstNameBillTo}} field, enter a new first name. 5. In the {{variable.Field_Invoice_LastNameBillTo}} field, enter a new last name. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 7. Click the {{variable.Field_Invoice_DocumentLink}} URL to view the changes. ![Update the fields on the DocumentLink](https://youtu.be/9_2uXivP25Y){height="480" width="640"}
